title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named downtown Hillsdale destinations on the Broad and Howell Street corridors, each with a documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Jilly Beans for coffee and baked goods
cards.subtitle: North Howell Street corridor — downtown Hillsdale
cards.notes: Walk the North Howell Street corridor to Jilly Beans when you want a coffee or baked good before continuing through downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale College identifies Jilly Beans as a downtown Hillsdale coffee shop serving drinks and baked goods.
cards.access_notes: Commercial business; confirm current service details directly before visiting.

cards.title: Checker Records for coffee and vinyl
cards.subtitle: South Howell Street corridor — downtown Hillsdale
cards.notes: Use this South Howell Street stop to pair a coffee break with browsing classic-rock vinyl records and music merchandise.
cards.short_summary: Coffee bar and music-store browsing in one storefront.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale College describes Checker Records as a coffee bar and classic music store with specialty drinks and vinyl records.
cards.access_notes: Commercial business; confirm current service details directly before visiting.

cards.title: Toasted Mud for paint-your-own pottery
cards.subtitle: North Howell Street corridor — downtown Hillsdale
cards.notes: Plan a hands-on break along North Howell Street by choosing a pottery piece and painting it at this downtown studio.
cards.short_summary: A downtown studio for painting pottery.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale College identifies Toasted Mud as a paint-your-own pottery studio.
cards.access_notes: Commercial studio; contact the business for current session and pickup information.

cards.title: Volume One for used-book browsing
cards.subtitle: North Broad Street corridor — downtown Hillsdale
cards.notes: Browse the used-book shelves on the North Broad Street corridor and leave time to look through the store’s eclectic selection.
cards.short_summary: A used bookstore on the downtown Broad Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale College describes Volume One as a used bookstore with books and cats.
cards.access_notes: Commercial business; confirm current opening details directly before visiting.

cards.title: St. Joe’s Café for sourdough and pastries
cards.subtitle: North Broad Street corridor — downtown Hillsdale
cards.notes: Add this North Broad Street café to a downtown walk for freshly baked sourdough bread, pastries, and its listed local fare.
cards.short_summary: A downtown café with baked bread and pastries.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Joe’s Café describes itself as a downtown Hillsdale café featuring freshly baked sourdough bread and pastries.
cards.access_notes: The café says it is moving and temporarily closing after July 25; check its site before making a trip.

cards.title: The Dawn Theater for a downtown performance
cards.subtitle: North Broad Street corridor — downtown Hillsdale
cards.notes: Check the theater’s current program before heading along North Broad Street for a scheduled performance or other ticketed event.
cards.short_summary: A named theater destination on North Broad Street.
cards.evidence_claim: A City of Hillsdale business guide lists The Dawn Theater at 110 N. Broad Street.
cards.source_title: Business Guide to the Hillsdale Social District | City of Hillsdale
cards.access_notes: Check the theater directly for its public event schedule and ticket requirements.

cards.title: Hillsdale County Courthouse for civic history
cards.subtitle: North Howell Street corridor — downtown Hillsdale
cards.notes: Walk past the courthouse on North Howell Street to see a central civic landmark, then use the county clerk page for service needs.
cards.short_summary: A county civic landmark anchoring the Howell Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale County lists the Hillsdale County Courthouse at 29 N. Howell Street.
cards.access_notes: Government offices have weekday hours and may have service-specific access rules.

cards.title: Courthouse Annex for a civic-services landmark
cards.subtitle: North Howell Street corridor — downtown Hillsdale
cards.notes: Continue up North Howell Street to the courthouse annex, a clearly named government destination with weekday public office hours.
cards.short_summary: A distinct courthouse annex on the Howell Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan’s 2B District Court page lists the Hillsdale County Courthouse Annex at 49 N. Howell Street.
cards.access_notes: The court office lists Monday–Friday hours; court proceedings and services can have separate rules.

cards.title: City Hall for a Broad Street civic stop
cards.subtitle: North Broad Street corridor — downtown Hillsdale
cards.notes: Use City Hall as a North Broad Street waypoint and consult the city’s public notices or calendar while exploring the downtown corridor.
cards.short_summary: The city government building on North Broad Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Hillsdale lists City Hall at 97 N. Broad Street.
cards.access_notes: City Hall lists Monday–Friday office hours; public meeting and service access varies.

cards.title: Courthouse Lawn Park for a shaded pause
cards.subtitle: North Howell Street corridor — downtown Hillsdale
cards.notes: Take a seated pause beside the North Howell Street corridor using the park’s benches, picnic tables, pavilion, and shaded lawn.
cards.short_summary: A small downtown park with seating and memorials.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale County’s recreation plan describes Courthouse Lawn Park as a downtown park with a pavilion, fountain, memorials, benches, and picnic tables.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public park; use normal park etiquette and observe any posted event restrictions.
